text: An AI agent just bought something for you.
The payment succeeded. But the delivery went wrong.
Who makes it right?
Meet Afterpact ... the assurance layer for agentic commerce.
No setup. No script to follow. One click runs the whole story ... a delivery gone wrong, recovered, held, and refused ... every step proven.
Then PayPal executes. Real orders. Real captures.
Recorded sandbox runs prove the loop end to end.
But here's what nobody shows you.
Three sensor kits were promised. Two arrived.
The Outcome Twin lays it bare: what was promised, what actually happened ... and what's still missing.
One kit. A hundred twenty-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents. Unaccounted for.
So Afterpact goes to work.
AI reads the evidence and proposes a partial refund.
A deterministic policy checks every cent against the capture.
A human approves. And PayPal confirms the refund ... verified at the provider, not just on screen.
Every step lands in the Flight Recorder.
A hash-chained, replayable record you can hand to your ops team ... or your auditor.
This isn't a demo trick. It's the artifact merchants keep.
The same evidence powers real intelligence.
Recorded model runs ... every citation checked ... and a licensed analytics studio, with its own AI risk analyst, over the same data.
Nothing here is faked. And everything is labeled.
And when something malicious shows up ... a merchant swap, an inflated amount ...
the policy engine refuses. Same input, same refusal. Forever.
AI can buy anything.
Afterpact makes sure the outcome matches the promise.
